description: How KeepUp users compare: net worth at the 25th, 50th, 75th and 90th percentiles and the asset class most of them are led by, worldwide or in one country, optionally within an age band. Rounded group figures over users on KeepUp's public leaderboard (groups of five or more), never an individual. A self-selected group, not a whole country's population.
